name: Heart of Isha Awak
summary: Along the Merchant Coast south of Ratchet, hunters seek Isha Awak’s heart. Mahren Skyseer wants it as proof that the Deep Doom has been overcome.

sections.title: Trophy of the Deep Doom
sections.body:
Isha Awak prowls the sea off the Merchant Coast, south of Ratchet. Sailors and coastal folk both revere and fear the massive thresher called the Deep Doom. It has killed many human trespassers along the shore.

Mahren Skyseer, a tauren mystic, sees an honorable predator rather than a mindless menace. She believes its fierce spirit dwells in its heart. So she sends brave hunters into the waves to defeat Isha Awak in its own domain and claim the heart as a trophy and spiritual offering.

faq.q: What is the Heart of Isha Awak?
faq.answer: Isha Awak’s heart comes from the giant thresher that prowls the waters south of Ratchet. Hunters claim it as proof that they have overcome the Deep Doom for Mahren Skyseer.

faq.q: Who wants the Heart of Isha Awak?
aliases: who do i give the heart to
faq.answer: Mahren Skyseer, a tauren seer camped along the Merchant Coast south of Ratchet, wants hunters to retrieve the heart. She seeks to honor the beast’s power and take its spirit into herself.
Isha Awak dwells in the ocean off the Merchant Coast in the eastern Barrens, south of Ratchet.

faq.q: Why does Mahren Skyseer want the heart?
aliases: why does mahren want the heart
faq.answer: Mahren Skyseer considers Isha Awak an honorable hunter and worthy adversary. By slaying the beast and holding its heart, a hunter takes the sea creature’s spirit within.

angles.text: As a tauren hunter, you pursue Isha Awak in communion with nature’s fiercest predators, guided by the elder Mahren Skyseer.
As a hunter, you face a test of courage as you track and conquer the Deep Doom beneath the Merchant Coast’s waves.
